# Meisel Health

> Premium health coaching for women over 40, founded by Alissa Meisel. Evidence-based guidance on GLP-1 therapy, peptide protocols, longevity medicine, and building a health coaching business.

## About

Meisel Health is a health coaching brand created by Alissa Meisel, a Board-Certified Health Coach and Master's-trained Occupational Therapist. After losing 160 pounds and undergoing her own health transformation, Alissa founded Meisel Health to give women over 40 real information and real protocols, not generic wellness advice. The brand focuses on GLP-1 and metabolic support, longevity and quality of life coaching, peptide protocol guidance, and mentoring health coaches who want to build their own practices.

## Services

- GLP-1 & Metabolic Support: Personalized coaching for women using GLP-1 medications like semaglutide and tirzepatide, with guidance on nutrition, muscle preservation, and metabolic health.
- Longevity & Quality of Life: Peptide protocols, NAD+, hormone optimization, sexual health, and science-backed strategies for women navigating midlife and beyond.
- Work With Me: 1:1 health coaching with Alissa for personalized protocol design and accountability.
- Build With Me: Business mentorship for health coaches who want to build a coaching practice using Alissa's framework.
